input.quote: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
input.rationale: The § 12.1 grant is expressly "revocable" with no stated standard, so IBM could withdraw use rights at will, and it runs to "Customer" only — Affiliates (a defined term in the preamble) and contractors operating the Services on our behalf are not covered, and § 14.17 confirms no rights beyond those expressly granted. Successor transfer is already protected by § 14.10 (assignment to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition), so the minimal edit adds affiliate/contractor scope and ties revocation to expiration or termination under Section 3.

proposal.summary: Extend Base Components licence to Customer Affiliates and contractors and remove revocability at will
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates and to contractors using the Services on our behalf, and removed "revocable" so the licence cannot be pulled at will — it should end only when this Agreement or the relevant Services terminate. If helpful, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement. Such license is irrevocable during the term of the applicable Services and may be terminated only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or the applicable Service Option Attachment in accordance with Section 3.
